title: Source Manifest
description: Human-intent declaration of third-party skill sources. File: skill-sys.sources.json

sources.description: List of skill sources to track and resolve.

name.description: Unique skill name within this manifest.

source.description: Git URL of the remote source repository.

ref.description: Git ref to resolve: branch, tag, or commit SHA.

skillPath.description: Directory path within the repository containing the skill. Defaults to repository root if omitted.
